properties.description: Four in_memory tests covering the three parts of requirement B: (1) confirmation_is_recorded_and_read_on_the_step — unconfirmed default and explicit person confirmation round-trip through add_inference and get_node; (2) proof_status_is_shown_when_unconfirmed_and_proven_when_confirmed — full shown→proven transition via revision with confirmation; (3) a_counterexample_contradicts_and_breaks_downstream_steps — CONTRADICTS edge makes truth fail, proof_status becomes unproven, downstream step fails; (4) a_bad_confirmed_how_is_refused — validation rejects invalid confirmed_how values. Full suite: 814 in_memory tests pass.
properties.findings: All 4 new tests pass. Full in_memory suite: 814 passed, 0 failed, 2 ignored. Enum wiring and toolsnap tests also pass.
properties.name: Proof confirmation and status tests (4 tests, PR #760)
